subject: Linkage section
notes: (kb/Work PB2671, which takes this row from PB1253.) cite.py --check 13.7.4 "A data-item format or table format VALUE clause specified in the linkage section is ignored except in the execution of an explicit or implicit INITIALIZE statement" -> OK 5); --check 13.7.4 "If the runtime element containing the linkage section is activated by a non-COBOL runtime element, the initial value of a linkage section data item is defined by the implementor" -> OK 5); twin --check 13.18.63.4 "In the linkage section, VALUE clauses take effect only during the execution of an explicit or implicit INITIALIZE statement" -> OK 3). The VALUE half is pinned by conformance:cases/13.7-Linkage-section/pb499_table_value_linkage_and_file_2002 (table format, VALUE ignored at activation and honoured by INITIALIZE). OS activation: undefined (A.2 item 24). The non-COBOL half is the DOC-A.1-116 determination: through ICobolProgram.Call a formal's initial value is the host's carrier; through ICobolProgram.Activate on a fresh instance it is the item's category default with no VALUE applied. NonCobolActivatorLinkageTests gives LA PIC X(4) VALUE "VVVV" and LN PIC 9(3) VALUE 5 and observes four spaces and 000 at the main entry, then the host's own values through the call. The data-item-format VALUE half is pinned by conformance:cases/13.7-Linkage-section/pb576_float_value_occasions (L4, a LINKAGE formal: on entry it holds the caller value, not its VALUE; after INITIALIZE the VALUE). The implicit-INITIALIZE leg is conformance:cases/13.7-Linkage-section/pb499_table_value_by_section_2002 (B, a BASED item in the LINKAGE SECTION: ALLOCATE ... INITIALIZED applies its VALUE); pb576's own ALLOCATE leg is a WORKING-STORAGE item and is not credited here (refuter round 2). The non-COBOL arm is measured again after the refuter round (addressed national and floating-point formals included). retired-witness: conformance-test:NonCobolActivatorLinkageTests.ANetHost_CallGuaranteesLinkageAccess_MainEntrySeesCategoryDefaultsOrTheLastCallsBinding (kb/Work PB2099 retired the untyped host route (ProgramRegistry.CallProgram/RunMain); the same witness, renamed, now hosts the generated entry)
